description.zh: 内容团队的最后一站：只发核验通过、用户已明确确认的文章。发布前检查核验结论为通过、初稿自核验后没改过（哈希一致）、用户在对话里确认；把文章排版后连同封面和正文图片存进微信公众号草稿箱（只存草稿，由用户到后台预览后自己发布），文末自动生成参考来源，去掉来源标记；同一版初稿不会重复提交；接口失败时给出错误码、原因和处理办法（IP 白名单、账号权限等）；小红书、头条等没有稳定接口的平台导出可复制的文本；每次发布记台账。密钥只从环境变量读取，不外露。
description.en: Last stop of the content team: publishes only articles that passed fact-checking and were explicitly confirmed by the user. Before publishing it checks the verdict is pass, the draft is unchanged since review (hash match) and the user confirmed in chat; lays out the article and saves it with cover and inline images to the WeChat Official Account draft box (drafts only, the user previews and publishes in the console), generating a reference list and stripping source markers; never submits the same draft twice; explains API failures (IP allowlist, account permissions); exports copy-ready text for platforms without stable APIs; keeps a ledger. Secrets are read from the environment only.

welcome_message.zh: 把核验通过的文章包给我，我先对一遍清单
welcome_message.en: Give me the verified article pack and I will run the checklist first

prompt.zh:
这篇文章已经核验通过，请检查后存入公众号草稿箱：
___
prompt.en:
This article passed fact-checking; check it and save it to the WeChat draft box:
___

prompt.zh: 帮我检查文章包 ___ 能不能发布：核验结论、初稿是否改过、还差什么。
prompt.en: Check whether article pack ___ can be published: verdict, whether the draft changed, what is missing.

title.en: 凭据和 IP 白名单

prompt.zh: 帮我检查公众号接口是否配置好：AppID、AppSecret 和 IP 白名单。
prompt.en: Check that the WeChat API is set up: AppID, AppSecret and IP allowlist.

prompt.zh: 把核验通过的文章包 ___ 导出成小红书的可复制文本，并提示超出限制的地方。
prompt.en: Export the verified pack ___ as copy-ready Xiaohongshu text and flag anything over the limits.

prompt.zh: 查一下发布台账，这篇文章（初稿哈希 ___）发过没有，最近发布了哪些。
prompt.en: Check the publish ledger: was this article (draft hash ___) sent, and what was published recently?

prompt.zh: 发布时报错：___，帮我判断原因并告诉我怎么处理。
prompt.en: Publishing failed with: ___ — find the cause and tell me what to do.

zh: 每周五「17:00」汇总本周发布台账：发了什么、失败了几次、原因
每月 1 日「10:00」检查公众号接口凭据和 IP 白名单是否仍然有效
每次发布前「立即」运行预检，确认核验通过且初稿未改动
每周一「9:00」列出草稿箱里还没有发布的稿子
每月最后一天「18:00」复盘本月失败的发布及处理办法
每季度第一天「10:00」提醒我检查公众号 AppSecret 是否需要轮换
en: Every Friday at 17:00, summarise this week's ledger: what was sent, failures and causes
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, check the API credentials and IP allowlist still work
Before each publish, run the pre-check: verified and draft unchanged
Every Monday at 9:00, list drafts still unpublished
On the last day of each month at 18:00, review failed publishes and fixes
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, remind me to consider rotating the AppSecret
